framing.lineOfInquiry: Sandeep Kapoor (P00352) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE040
framing.alternate: Sandeep Kapoor (P00352) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sandeep Kapoor's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: In contact with Manpreet Rawat since 2025-05-11, 28 days before the incident (4 calls, 10 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Gurpreet Rana since 2025-05-13, 26 days before the incident (11 calls, 9 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sandeep Kapoor was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 41 other days (11 May – 30 Jun), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error

alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

comparison.verdict: Every supporting item could be explained by at least one alternate, although the line of inquiry is stronger on weight (0.48 vs 0.35). Test the alternates before relying on it.
